code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # The repeated lattice has separator rows/columns. Sample their intersections,
    # omitting the last boundary, and replace ordinary line color with tile background.
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # separator rows/cols are every repeated grid pitch; infer from dense uniform lines
    rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if max(Counter(row).values()) >= w-2]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j]==grid[0][j] for i in range(h))>=h-2]
    # take separator positions from recurring horizontal/vertical lines, excluding terminal boundary
    rows=[i for i in rows if i+1<h]
    cols=[j for j in cols if j+1<w]
    line=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common()
    # ordinary gridline is most frequent color other than background
    linecolor=next((x for x,n in line if x!=bg), None)
    return [[bg if grid[r][c]==linecolor else grid[r][c] for c in cols] for r in rows]
'''
